subject: 介休后土庙三清楼北面戏台与八字影壁
caption: 介休后土庙 · 三清楼北面戏台
明清 · 戏台与八字影壁
source_note: 所绘严格限实照可见三清楼北面戏台及紧接的八字影壁，未臆画南面献亭或整座庙群。保留高台下架空通道、通高前柱、抱厦和影壁双层小檐；屋顶、浮雕仅稀疏勾勒。输入输出已目视核对。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Subject: the actual NORTH-FACING OPERA STAGE on the rear of SANQING LOU at JIEXIU HOUTU TEMPLE 介休后土庙三清楼北面戏台, together with its two immediate angled BAGUA-style wing SCREEN WALLS 八字影壁. Photo2 is the exact nearfrontal view to reproduce. Preserve the high wooden stage floor about one person above ground with visible short stone/timber supports and OPEN VOID below it, two extremely tall front columns from ground to the projecting upper roof, the central open front stage bay and recessed narrow side bays. The large central projecting stage roof is taller than the side roofs, ornate end finials and small central ridge ornaments, deep broad bracket sets below; draw these selectively. Preserve the actual two flanking angled masonry screen walls each crowned with TWO small roof/eave levels separated by short open columns, with one large ROUND glazed medallion in the square panel below; their inward angled placement and their low height relative to main roof are essential. Do not turn wing walls into free standing pagodas. Use the precise photographed roof arrangement, not a generic symmetrical two-storey Chinese hall. Do not invent the unphotographed south-facing portion of Sanqinglou. Keep the full width of both screens and center roof within white margins, while omit cropped peripheral outer courtyard structures. Remove all people, stored planks, fire extinguisher, electric wires, writing and plaques. Render the medallions with a few graceful curled contours, not fully copied dense tessellation. All roof surfaces, columns, shadows under the elevated stage remain WHITE inside thin BLACK outlines. NO dark filled open stage, NO dense roof tile rows or crosshatching. Keep structural divisions but greatly reduce ornamental line density to match master. historical_sources.title: 后土庙
historical_sources.publisher: 介休文化云（介休市文化旅游发展委员会及市公共文化场馆）
historical_sources.evidence: 现存建筑主要明洪武至清道光修葺，三清楼背面为戏台，重檐悬山加歇山抱厦并八字影壁。页面正德十四与1516对应有误，本条只采用正德时期及明清修缮判断，不强定单一年份。

historical_sources.title: 介休后土庙建筑艺术赏析
historical_sources.publisher: 温春爱，《文物世界》2006年第6期（转载）
historical_sources.evidence: 直接援引《重修太宁宫殿并创建三门记》等碑刻，记正德丙子重建及增建献亭、乐楼两廊，区分元1309创建三清观与现存明清建筑风貌。

site_recommendation.name: 介休后土庙
site_recommendation.yearNote: 约以正德时期三清楼与献楼营建作为排序点；碑记及来源1516、1519各有所指，不将1519强作所绘全部构件竣工年。
site_recommendation.lede: 三清楼背面兼作后土庙戏台，高高架起的舞台夹在两座八字影壁之间。层叠屋檐与琉璃脊饰，将供奉神祇和酬神演戏的空间紧密组合。

facts.label: 殿台合一
facts.text: 三清楼集殿、楼、台于一体，北面戏台突出抱厦，与两侧八字影壁形成围合。

facts.label: 明清营建
facts.text: 现存建筑格局主要形成于明清；元代创建三清观的记载不等于图中戏台全部为元构。

facts.label: 琉璃装饰
facts.text: 屋脊与影壁广施彩色琉璃，线稿以细线保留主要轮廓和图案位置。
